typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	CCEmail as string (),
	Destination as string (),
	FailureEmail as string (),
	FILENAME as string (),
	Outbound_Location as string (),
	RowCnt as integer (),
	SuccessEmail as string (),
	TemplateFile as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Last Name} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		MI as string,
		{Address 1} as string,
		{Address 2} as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		Phone as string,
		Medicaid_no as string,
		DOB as string,
		Gender as string,
		MBI as string,
		{Medicaid MCO} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [Last Name] ,[First Name] ,[MI] ,[Address 1] ,[Address 2] ,[City] ,[State] ,[Zip] ,[Phone] ,[Medicaid_no] ,[DOB] ,[Gender] ,[MBI] ,[Medicaid MCO] FROM EXTRACT.LA_DSNP_MEMBER_ENROLLMENT_STAGING',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Medicaid_no} = Medicaid_no,
		{Copy of City} = City,
		{Copy of State} = State,
		{Copy of MBI} = MBI,
		{Copy of Phone} = Phone,
		{Copy of DOB} = DOB,
		{Copy of Zip} = Zip,
		{Copy of Gender} = Gender,
		{Copy of MI} = MI) ~> DataConversion
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
DataConversion sink(input(
		{Copy of Zip} as string,
		{Copy of Medicaid MCO} as string,
		{Copy of City} as string,
		{Copy of Gender} as string,
		{Copy of First Name} as string,
		{Copy of Address 1} as string,
		{Copy of Last Name} as string,
		{Copy of Address 2} as string,
		{Copy of Medicaid_no} as string,
		{Copy of MBI} as string,
		{Copy of State} as string,
		{Copy of Phone} as string,
		{Copy of DOB} as string,
		{Copy of MI} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
